coach.title: Chat
coach.name: Loggy
coach.workoutGenerationPrompt: I can help you create a personalized workout plan! Tell me about your goals, available equipment, and how many days per week you'd like to train.
coach.mealPlanPrompt: I can help you create a personalized meal plan for 3 days! Tell me about your preferences, allergies, or any specific foods you'd like to include.
coach.analyzeProgressPrompt: I'll analyze your recent workouts. Any remarks you'd like to tell me before I do?
coach.nutritionCheckPrompt: I'll review your nutrition for the last 7 days. Any remarks you'd like to add before I do?
coach.trackMealPrompt: Tell me what you've eaten (you can even send a photo!), and I'll estimate the macros and track it for you.
coach.welcomeMessage: Hi, I'm {{name}}, your AI coach. Ask me anything about your workouts, nutrition or progress.
coach.welcomeMessageExercise: Hi, I'm {{name}}. Ask me to build a workout plan, check your form or analyze your progress.
coach.welcomeMessageNutrition: Hi, I'm {{name}}. Tell me what you ate and I'll estimate the macros, or ask me a nutrition question.

insights.noNutritionLogs: I can't give nutrition insights yet because you haven't tracked any meals in the past 7 days. Log your food and I'll have feedback for you.
insights.noWorkoutLogs: I can't give workout insights yet because you haven't completed a workout in the past 7 days. Finish one and I'll analyze your training.

errors.aiNotConfigured: AI features are not configured. Please add a Gemini or OpenAI API key in Settings.
errors.workoutGenerationFailed: Sorry, I couldn't generate a workout plan. Please try again.
errors.mealPlanGenerationFailed: Sorry, I couldn't generate a meal plan. Please try again.
errors.generalError: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.progressInsightFailed: Could not analyze progress. Try again later.
errors.nutritionInsightFailed: Could not check nutrition. Try again later.
errors.trackMealFailed: I couldn't estimate the macros for that meal. Could you describe it in more detail?
errors.featureRequiresCloudAi: This feature is not available with Apple Intelligence. Please switch to OpenAI or Gemini in Settings.
errors.filePickFailed: Failed to pick file. Please try again.
errors.creditsExhausted: It looks like your AI credits have run out. Please check your API key or billing in Settings.
errors.rateLimited: Please wait a moment before sending another message.
errors.toolRequestFailed: I could not process that request. Please try again.
errors.conversationFallback: I can help you with fitness and nutrition questions. What would you like to know?
errors.requestProcessingFailed: I had trouble processing your request. Could you try rephrasing that?

success.workoutPlanGeneratedWithName: I've created {{planName}} with {{count}} workouts for you! 💪 {{description}}
success.mealPlanGenerated: I've created a 3-day meal plan with {{count}} meals for you! 🥗 {{description}}
success.trackMealSuccess: I've tracked {{count}} ingredients for your meal: {{ingredients}}. Total: {{calories}} kcal.
success.trackMealReady: I've analyzed {{count}} meal(s): {{meals}} ({{calories}} kcal total). Tap a meal to review and log it.

aiInstructions.parseWorkouts: Parse the workouts and return the structured list.
aiInstructions.parseNutrition: Parse the nutrition data and return the structured list.
aiInstructions.parseRetrospectiveNutrition: Parse the meals and return the structured list.
aiInstructions.generateWorkoutPlanWithHistory: Generate a workout plan based on this conversation.
aiInstructions.generateWorkoutPlanDefault: Generate a basic weekly workout plan (e.g. 3-day split).

personaPicker.title: Coach personality
personaPicker.subtitle: Choose who your coach is. Only the way it talks changes; the advice and rules stay the same.
personaPicker.onDeviceNote: On-device AI always uses Loggy. Switch to a cloud or local AI to pick a different coach.

custom.title: Custom coach
custom.voicePlaceholder: e.g. A calm drill sergeant who respects effort and never lets me skip leg day.
custom.hint: Your description is sent to the AI with your messages. It only changes the tone, not the advice.
custom.errorUnsafe: That text can’t be used. Try describing the voice in simpler words.
